;''TLI, The Loglan Institute''
:The organization coordinating the development and use of [[Loglan|Loglan]].

[[Randall Holmes]] has been the CEO ("cefli") since 2008.

== Executive history ==

TLI was run by [[James Cooke Brown]] from the time of its foundation until 2000, when [[Alex Leith]] took over as Chairman and CEO. Leith died in 2001, and [[Robert McIvor]] assumed responsibility. In 2008, McIvor sought a volunteer to take over the organization and Randall Holmes stepped forward.
